selectionEntries.comment:
GS39 PRACTICE: Practice now uses the exact same Extra Unit Copy Cost branch as Quick: four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. The Practice branch below is derived from the current Quick branch; Standard and Long arithmetic are unchanged.

EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent. Light Troupe (5), Dark Troupe (5), and Twilight Troupe (5) remain the three independent Troop copy families; Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver remain the three Other copy families. Normal-copy allowances are Practice 3 / 0, Quick 4 / 1, Standard 6 / 2, and Long 8 / 3 for Troop / Other respectively. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Harlequins 3.3.6

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Changelog (September 24th)

• Presentation: improved spacing after ◆ unit markers in roster exports.

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering and ◆ unit presentation.
• Shared library: synchronized all ten playable entryLinks to Harlequins Library V19 while preserving library-owned points, Leader Points, loadouts, attachments, validation, and shared semantic categories.

## Changelog (September 19th)

• Added 420 Point Practice support and refreshed Unit Ability/list presentation across all Harlequin datasheets.
• Playable Harlequins and the shared library were synchronized so unit presentation and abilities remain consistent across consumers.
• Troupe copy-cost rules now support Practice while preserving the existing Quick, Standard, and Long thresholds.
• Existing Leader Point, attachment, Rare, transport, and shared-library behavior was preserved.

## Changelog (September 16th)

• Added model-count suffixes to Light Troupe (5), Dark Troupe (5), and Twilight Troupe (5).
• Leader Points: Troupe Master and Shadowseer cost 1 LP each through their shared Harlequins Library roots.
• Extra Unit Copy Costs now correctly applies Troop copy surcharges to Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe using the 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance.
• Catalogue maintenance documentation was consolidated for the Harlequins 3.3.6 / GS27 baseline.

catalogue.comment:
REV25 / GS40 — FINAL CURRENT-STATE REFRESH
Corrected the remaining present-tense Practice copy allowance note to the live GS39+ Quick-equivalent 4 Troop / 1 Other baseline. Harlequins Library V24 remains the current shared source. Historical pre-GS39 notes remain unchanged. No executable mechanics changed.

REV24 / GS40 — HARLEQUINS LIBRARY V24 REFERENCE REFRESH
Updated only the present-tense shared-library reference from Harlequins Library V23 to V24. Library V24 is a documentation-only successor to V23, so all ten stable entryLink targets and executable shared-unit payloads remain unchanged. Historical synchronization records remain unchanged. No list-construction mechanics changed.

REV23 / GS40 — CHANGELOG CLEANUP / LIBRARY CURRENT-STATE REFRESH
Standardized the player-facing maintenance history as Changelog and simplified repeated wording while preserving all substantive dated changes. Present-tense documentation now identifies Game System revision 40 and the verified Harlequins Library V23. Historical V18/V19 synchronization records remain unchanged. No IDs, targets, points, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, attachment behavior, category ownership, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV22 / GS40 — DIAMOND EXPORT SPACING
Added exactly one additional literal space after every diamond unit-marker character in catalogue-owned strings. Unit names and childName mirrors therefore remain synchronized. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV21 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV20 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. The local Extra Unit Copy Costs Practice branch is now an exact clone of the current Quick branch, giving Practice four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE
Playable Harlequins adapter for Harlequins 3.3.6 on Game System revision 40. All ten playable unit trees are supplied by the linked Harlequins 3.3.6 - Library V24; this catalogue owns root availability, primary presentation categories, Patch Notes, and standalone Extra Unit Copy Costs accounting.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
The library link does not import root entries automatically; the ten stable entryLinks are the playable roster surface. Extra Unit Copy Costs is a permanent required Configuration entry. Its Troop arithmetic charges +20 Points per identical Light Troupe (5), Dark Troupe (5), or Twilight Troupe (5) beyond the selected Game Size's normal allowance. Its Other arithmetic does the same for Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other. Duplicate Extra Unit Copy Costs entries use the custom automatic_configuration_duplicate error; missing-entry validation is owned by the Game System Required Extra Unit Copy Costs Configuration semantic.

Harlequins Library V24 owns the ten shared unit trees, intrinsic points and Leader Points, loadouts, paid wargear, attachment associations, reusable semantic categories, current presentation, and top-level Unit Ability profiles. This playable adapter stores no local LP costs, preventing double charging. Troupe Master is the sole  command root; Shadowseer remains a 1-LP Leader without the command marker. Unit Ability profiles include top-level ability names only; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted.

HISTORICAL REVISION LOG
REV8: New Recruit cost-type compatibility sync. REV9-10: presentation / error-UX companion cleanup. V11: Harlequins 3.3.5 title and standard Patch Notes baseline. V12: Harlequins 3.3.6 and GS21 baseline sync. V13: unified Troops / Other Additional Copy Costs presentation and fixed missing standalone Troop copy surcharges.
V14: Leader Points migration companion for Harlequins Library REV15. Troupe Master and Shadowseer inherit their intrinsic 1 LP costs from the shared library roots. This playable adapter intentionally contains no local LP costs, preventing double charging. Retargeted to Game System revision 24. Existing library link target, entryLink target IDs, root availability, primary presentation categories, Additional Copy Costs arithmetic, Patch Notes structure, and all unrelated playable-catalogue mechanics remain unchanged.

V15 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP
Runtime validation passed for Troupe Master and Shadowseer through the playable Harlequins adapter. The playable catalogue stores no LP costs and no Counts Toward Leader Maximum tags; intrinsic Leader Points remain owned by the shared Harlequins Library roots exactly once. No adapter entryLinks, Roaming Performers behavior, Additional Copy Costs, points, loadouts, or other playable-catalogue mechanics changed. Patch Notes presentation was updated to the September 14th cleanup convention.

V16 — TROUPE MODEL-COUNT PRESENTATION
Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe now display as fixed five-model units. Playable entryLink labels and shared-library roots were synchronized. Stable IDs, points, loadouts, Additional Copy Costs, Leader Points, and all other mechanics are unchanged.

V17 — CURRENT TEMPLATE / PRACTICE / UNIT ABILITIES / LIBRARY V18 SYNC
Consolidated current-template update from the live V16 baseline. Retargeted to Game System revision 37; renamed Additional Copy Costs to Extra Unit Copy Costs; added 420 Point Practice compatibility; flattened the visible Troops/Other accounting children into one Extra Unit Copy Costs entry while preserving existing Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic; synchronized all ten entryLink names to Harlequins Library V18 current presentation; and surfaced the library-owned top-level Unit Ability profiles through those shared roots. The playable adapter continues to own no intrinsic unit costs or LP costs.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY AUDIT: all top-level Harlequin Unit Abilities in the supplied map are intrinsic to their datasheets. No top-level ability corresponds to an optional selectable upgrade, so no conditional profile ownership is required.

V18 — DIAMOND UNIT MARKERS / LIBRARY V19 SYNC
Replaced remaining unit and linked-unit chevrons with ◆  throughout the playable adapter and synchronized all ten playable entryLink names to Harlequins Library V19 by stable target ID. Harlequins has no Additional Model checkbox entries, so no markerless Additional Model conversion was required. Existing Extra Unit Copy Costs arithmetic, primary presentation categories, library targets, IDs, constraints, modifiers, and all playable-adapter mechanics are unchanged.
